Name: Renew wildcard SSL and internal CA certificates with auto-renewal
Description:
Owner: Ben. Renew and deploy certificates before expiry with auto-renewal via cert-manager.

Steps:
1. Renew wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com which expires September 1st. Target deployment complete by August 22nd to provide buffer.
2. Deploy renewed wildcard cert to all load balancers serving api.ourapp.com and verify TLS handshake.
3. Migrate certificate management to cert-manager for the wildcard cert to enable auto-renewal going forward.
4. In the same change window, rotate the internal CA certificate that signs the service mesh. It expires two weeks after the public wildcard cert.
5. Migrate internal CA cert to cert-manager auto-renewal as well.

Acceptance criteria:
- Wildcard cert for api.ourapp.com is renewed, deployed to load balancers, and valid before August 22nd.
- cert-manager is configured and tested for automatic renewal of wildcard cert.
- Internal service mesh CA cert is rotated before expiry.
- cert-manager is configured and tested for automatic renewal of internal CA cert.
- No manual renewal required for either cert after completion.

Name: Implement PDF export for reports with demo GIF
Description:
Owner: Aisha. Deliver PDF export feature for reports, both backend and frontend, and provide marketing demo asset.

Steps:
1. Backend: Render reports to PDF using headless Chrome.
2. Frontend: Add export button to reports UI and implement progress state for reports that take a few seconds to generate.
3. Integrate backend rendering with frontend export flow and test with large reports.
4. Record a short demo GIF of the export feature for marketing changelog as part of completion.

Acceptance criteria:
- Reports can be exported to PDF from the frontend.
- PDF rendering uses headless Chrome and produces correct output for standard and large reports.
- Export button shows progress state while generation is in progress.
- Feature is complete by end of month.
- Demo GIF is recorded and handed off to marketing for changelog.

Name: Restore staging parity with production and automate drift detection
Description:
Owner: Ben. Bring staging environment up to date with production and prevent future drift.

Steps:
1. Immediately run the three pending database migrations on staging that are behind production.
2. Verify staging schema matches production after migration.
3. Write a nightly job that diffs staging schema against production schema.
4. Configure job to post an alert to the infra channel if divergence is detected.

Acceptance criteria:
- Staging database is migrated to match production, no longer three migrations behind.
- QA can validate against current production schema.
- Nightly drift detection job is running and posting to infra channel on divergence.
- No manual schema drift between staging and production going forward.
